units.source_text: 在从前，无论何事，凡是有关娱乐的，源氏必然特地召唤柏木卫门督前来，和他商量办法。

en.t: In former days, whenever anything had to do with entertainment, Genji would always summon Kashiwagi, the Emon no Kami, and consult with him about what to do.
But lately he had completely stopped communicating with him.

units.source_text: 他也曾顾虑到别人疑心，然而又想：“如果和他见面，他把我看作毫不知情的糊涂汉，我很可耻；

en.t: He had worried that others might become suspicious, yet he also thought, "If I meet him, and he sees me as a foolish man who knows nothing, it would be deeply shameful for me;

units.source_text: 我看到他，也不能平心静气。”

en.t: and when I look at him, I cannot remain calm either."

units.source_text: 因此柏木好几个月不来参谒，他也并不怪他。

en.t: For that reason, although Kashiwagi did not come to pay his respects for several months, Genji did not reproach him.

units.source_text: 一般人总以为柏木还在生病，而六条院今年也不办游宴之会。

en.t: Most people assumed that Kashiwagi was still ill, and the Rokujo estate held no banquets or entertainments that year.

units.source_text: 只有夕雾大将猜到几分，他想：“其中定有缘故。

en.t: Only Captain Yugiri guessed a little of the truth, thinking, "There must certainly be some reason behind this.

units.source_text: 柏木是个好色之徒，我早就看出他的心事，大约不堪相思之苦了。”

en.t: Kashiwagi is a man given to love affairs; I saw what was in his heart long ago, and he is probably unable to bear the torment of longing."

units.source_text: 但他不曾想到已经成了铁定无疑的事实。

en.t: But he never imagined that it had already become an undeniable fact.
